evidence_spans: We predict the Born effective charges and piezoelectric tensors of cubic and tetragonal BaTiO3.
CLM-MAT-0419.statement: WannDiffuse finite-difference calculation predicts a Ba Born effective charge of 2.758 e for cubic BaTiO3.

extra_quotes: Here we introduce WannDiffuse, a universal diffusion model for the quantum position operator based on predicting the centres and real-space localization of MLWFs.
Our framework combines E(3)-equivariant graph neural networks based on NequIP [36, 37] with a generative diffusion process [38–42] to predict WCCs and spreads directly from atomic configurations.

DFT calculations for liquid water, amorphous Silicon and Barium titanate were performed using Quantum ESPRESSO [69–71] in conjunction with the SSSP Efficiency pseudopotential library (version 1.3, PBEsol functional) [72–78].
Of these, we retained 2907 structures for which all semicore states were fully Wannierized, since the diffusion model requires a constant number of WCCs per chemical species.
